summary: Verified slimmed /app/backend/requirements.txt (Railway-ready) still supports all KasFlow backend features. Ran 11 pytest cases against public preview URL covering health, transactions CRUD, validation, GridFS evidence upload/download, invalid IDs, and cascade delete of GridFS files on transaction deletion. All 11/11 passed.
critical_code_review_comments: requirements.txt is now clean and Railway-compatible: only fastapi, uvicorn, python-dotenv, pymongo, motor, pydantic, python-multipart. `bson` is bundled with pymongo so no extra dep needed.
server.py uses `@app.on_event('shutdown')` which is deprecated in FastAPI/Starlette; consider lifespan context manager for future FastAPI upgrades (non-blocking).
Evidence upload reads entire file into memory before size check; for 10 MB cap this is fine but ideally stream via bucket.open_upload_stream and enforce a max Content-Length header check earlier.
GET /api/evidence/{id} returns 404 for missing files by catching bare Exception; specific NoFile catch would be cleaner.
CORS is set to '*' via env; fine for MVP but for Railway prod set explicit GitHub Pages origin.
seed_data_creation: Test data prefixed with TEST_ and cleaned up per test (delete transaction). Some orphan GridFS evidence blobs from upload-only tests remain (test_upload_evidence_png, test_get_evidence_streams_content) but are small (~70 bytes each) and harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green after requirements.txt slim-down. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_kasflow_api.py can be reused as regression suite. It hits the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Generates a valid 1x1 PNG in-memory for GridFS tests. Cascade delete test also verifies evidence 404 after linked transaction deletion.
rca of the issue: Not applicable - no bugs found. Railway build failure was already root-caused by main agent (private emergentintegrations pkg + jq + dev tools in requirements.txt). Slimmed requirements.txt verified: all deps resolve from public PyPI (pip --dry-run OK), and all backend endpoints continue to work correctly under supervisor.
